title: Karui

{{Distinguish2|the NPC, [[Kurai, the Administrator]]}} The '''Karui''' are a race/faction of the [[Wraeclast]]. They worship the [[Karui Gods]] and live in tribes amongst [[Karui Archipelago]] and [[Ngamakanui]]. The Karui were once slaves of [[Oriath]]. The Karui are inspired by the [[wikipedia:Māori people|Māori people]]. ==Notable members== * [[King Kaom]] * [[Queen Hyrri Ngamaku]] * [[Haku, Armourmaster]], a removed NPC * [[Haku, Warmaster]], a member of Immortal Syndicate and hostile to the player character * [[Marauder]], one of the playable character classes * [[Navali]], a NPC from [[Prophecy league]] and [[Ancestor league]] * [[Maramoa]], a NPC * [[Siosa]], a NPC * [[Lani]], a half-Karui NPC * [[Utula]], an allies NPC and later hostile monster * [[Whakano, the Barber]], a NPC * [[Tane Octavius]], a NPC ===Karui chieftains=== * [[Kaom]], chieftain of the [[Ngamahu]] tribe * [[Rakiata]], chieftain of the [[Tasalio]] tribe * [[Ikiaho]], chieftain of the [[Arohongui]] tribe * [[Kiloava]], chieftain of the [[Valako]] tribe * [[Tawhanuku]], chieftain of the [[Hinekora]] tribe * [[Maata]], chieftain of the [[Tawhoa]] tribe * [[Utula]], chieftain of the [[Kitava]] tribe * [[Kahuturoa]], chieftain of the [[Rongokurai]] tribe * [[Ahuana (Karui chieftain)|Ahuana]], chieftain of the [[Ramako]] tribe * [[Akoya]], chieftain of the [[Tukohama]] tribe ===Lavianga=== {{main|Lavianga}} Lavianga, is a historical figure of Wraeclast. They were an advisor to King Kaom, the former king of the Karui. They have no in-game depicted and are only referred to by the flavour texts of several Karui-related [[unique]] [[item]]s. They are also referred to as "Lavianga, Guardian of the Karui Way" and "Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom". ==Culture== The native Karui live as numerous tribes scattered throughout the Karui archipelago. They live a nomadic lifestyle, often moving between islands on canoes. There is also a large population of enslaved Karui who have been abducted from their homes by the [[Eternal Empire]] and [[Oriath]]. The Karui tribes are grouped by the Karui Ancestor they currently worship, lead by a chieftain. The Ancestor they worship are not set in stone, and members or even entire tribes may switch to honoring a different Ancestor should they find their current one unworthy. The Karui place great importance in strength, honoring warriors that possess great strength and martial prowess, and see those that lack strength or avoid fighting as dishonorable. The Karui are particularly susceptible to the effects of corruption. A Karui exposed to corruption often go into an uncontrollable rage, which can spread to others. They call this condition the "blood fever". There are many proverbs and wisdoms of Karui culture.
Shoot first, ask no questions." - Karui wisdom{{efn|{{il|Karui Ward}}}}
===Karui Way=== The "Karui Way" is a central aspect of Karui culture. According to {{il|The Gull}}, through delivering "Man unto Ancestor", its the Gull that gives the Karui their "Way". The flavour text of {{il|The Blood Dance}} refers to [[Lavianga]] as the "Guardian of the Karui Way". ===Ancestors=== The Karui Ancestors are a central aspect of Karui culture. Through the consuming of their flesh and seeding their souls "unto the earth", it the Gull that "delivers Man unto Ancestor".{{efn|{{il|The Gull}}}}
"When the Ancestors fill your cup, It is only good manners to drink your fill." - Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom{{efn|{{il|Lavianga's Spirit}}}}
===Afterlife=== Thanks to the work of [[Hinekora]], Mother of Death, the souls of all Karui that have died are sent to the [[Halls of the Dead]], where they continue to exist in the afterlife until the end of time. To pass time in the afterlife, the Karui participate in ritualistic combat in honor of the Ancestor, which they call the [[Trial of the Ancestors]]. While participation is not mandatory, refusing to participate is seen as dishonorable. It is possible to enter the Hall of the Dead from the living world. Its entrance is found in the [[poe2wiki:Eye of Hinekora|Eye of Hinekora]]. The living can temporarily enter the Halls of the Dead by looking into the Water of Sight, which induces the living into a state of near-death. The dead can also enter the living world for very brief moments and communicate with them when the moon aligns a certain way. Each tribe has a different tale on what will happen at the End of Time. ==Cultural Figures== There are many figures embedded within Karui tradition and culture. ===The Great Spirit=== The Great Spirit is a being that is believed to take the spirits of deceased Karui onto the Karui afterlife.
It is said to make you invisible when the Great Spirit comes to take you on your final journey.{{efn|{{il|Araku Tiki}}}}
===The Gull=== Referred only by the flavour text of {{il|The Gull}}, the Gull is a figure that connects the ideas of the Ancestors and the Karui Way.
"It is the Gull that delivers Man unto Ancestor. The consumer of our flesh. The seeder of our souls unto the earth. We give the Gull his life. The Gull gives us our Way." - Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
===Kaom=== [[King Kaom|Kaom]] started as a chieftain of the Ngamahu tribe. One by one, Kaom had conquered the weaker tribes by slaying their chieftains in ritual combat, eventually becoming King Kaom, leading the entire Karui under his name. Kaom was recruited by [[Voll]] in the [[Purity Rebellion]], slaughtering many Eternals, including his [[Marceus Lioneye]]. After the Purity Rebellion, through the machinations of [[Malachai, The Nightmare|Malachai]] taking over [[the Beast]], Kaom succumbed to the effects of corruption, seeing visions from the Ancestors and slaughtering his own men, before being sealed within [[Highgate]] along with the Beast and forced to exist in the Nightmare realm for centuries. Kaom was succeeded by his niece, [[Hyrri]], who would take over as the Queen. Hyrri would one day disappear when she took her army to investigate a mysterious [[Legion|monolith]]. Her daughter, [[Ahuana (Karui chieftain)|Ahuana]], took her place, but lacking her mother and uncle's leadership and influence, she decided to have the tribes go their separate ways. ==Language== The Karui language is known as "Karui". {| class="wikitable" |- !
